What I need from you: Growth Mindset

children.label: What I need from you: Growth Mindset

children.value: AI (or ML) is not a well-defined technology, but a cultural affinity signal of disregard for harms resulting from shoddy systems.
I think we should shed the idea that AI is a technological artifact with political features and recognize it as a political artifact through and through.
AI is an ideological project to shift authority and autonomy away from individuals, towards centralized structures of power.
The killing, silencing, annihilation, or devaluing of a knowledge system. The deliberated and systematic destruction of knowledge and societal ability to acquire knowledge.
Professionalism is understanding how to ask questions and how to assess reliability. This involves not just “looking right”, but being “right for the right reasons” (cf. “construct validity”).

My goal is not to coach you to producing an artifact, but to foster your mental model of the subject matter. That is often done through activities that produce artifacts. “AI” products are counterfeit artifacts, not a product of a consistent mental model.
Please do not use “AI” in this course. I will not surveil you, and I cannot check that you aren’t using it.
An intellectual property and indemnification disaster.
Please don’t upload my course materials there (or to any such service).
Please do use devices that record or otherwise process classroom interactions without affirmative consent from everyone here.
